categories.main_business_segments: Wens Foodstuff Group primarily operates in large-scale breeding and sales of broiler chickens and pigs, with additional activities in duck, layer hens, and pigeon breeding. The company also engages in related upstream and downstream businesses including slaughtering, food processing, veterinary drug production, agricultural equipment manufacturing, and financial investment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies in poultry and pig breeding, feed formulation, disease prevention, and intelligent farming. It employs a tight 'company + farmer' cooperative model, leveraging advanced breeding techniques such as genomic selection and gene editing, and maintains a comprehensive biosecurity system. The company also invests in environmental protection technologies and digital transformation including AI and big data applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Wens serves wholesale distributors and retail end customers including households, restaurants, and institutional food service providers. Its broiler chicken products mainly target wholesale markets, while pig products are sold to wholesalers and meat processing plants. The company also supplies processed fresh and prepared foods to large food processors and catering enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide across China with regional divisions in South China, Northeast, East China, Southwest, Central China, North China, and Northwest China. It has extensive operations in provinces such as Guangdong, Guangxi, Jiangsu, Anhui, Hunan, Sichuan, and others, covering major agricultural and livestock production areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wens operates across the entire livestock supply chain, including upstream breeding and feed production, midstream farming via contracted farmers, and downstream slaughtering, processing, and distribution. The company controls breeding stock and feed inputs, manages farming operations through its cooperative model, and handles product sales and processing, positioning it as an integrated agribusiness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in breeding technologies, disease control, nutrition, environmental management, and digital transformation. It maintains a close 'industry-academia-research' collaboration system and invests heavily in R&D projects focused on genetic improvement, biosecurity, sustainable farming, and smart agriculture. Digitalization and AI integration are key themes to enhance operational efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of live broiler chickens and pigs, fresh and processed meat products, and related agricultural products. The company also earns income from veterinary drugs, feed, agricultural equipment sales, and financial investments. Sales are conducted mainly on a wholesale basis with direct sales to distributors and institutional clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Wens is a leading player in China's modern livestock industry, ranking among the top in broiler chicken and pig production volumes nationally. It holds a dominant market share in the listed company segment and is recognized as a national key agricultural industrialization enterprise. Competitors include other large-scale integrated livestock companies and regional players in poultry and pig farming.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Wens reported total revenue of approximately RMB 104.86 billion, a 16.64% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 9.23 billion, a significant turnaround from losses in the prior year. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 93.86 billion with steady growth and improved asset turnover. It maintains a strong cash flow position and continues to invest in capacity expansion and technology.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wens emphasizes its proprietary breeding technologies, especially in yellow-feathered chicken and lean pork breeds, ensuring product quality and safety. Its 'company + farmer' model integrates smallholders into a modern, efficient supply chain, balancing scale with risk control. The company’s comprehensive biosecurity, environmental sustainability efforts, and digital management systems differentiate it as a high-quality, reliable supplier in the livestock industry.
